text:
Adam Fantilli is playing nearly 21 minutes a night at 22, and the points haven't followed. Six in 15 games, and none in his last five, with his chances thinning out over that stretch.

It isn't all bad luck. His 4.7 expected goals are close to his four goals, so he is finishing roughly as his chances deserve; there just haven't been many good ones lately, and Columbus roughly breaks even on shot attempts at 5-on-5 with him on. His 45 shots and 33 hits say he is involved. The points per 60 are well below the range our numbers expect from him.

Last season gives two clues. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 7.4 chances per 60 from the slot, 93rd percentile among forwards, so the offense has been there before. Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating a lot against him (bottom 6% of forwards), which is the part of the big-minutes job to watch. Our range has him at 44 to 69 points.
headline: Fantilli is playing big minutes without the points
